instructions: Optional: If you reject a code review suggestion, journal why: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <reason>'`.
Commit and push any changes to the PR head.

`$CHANGE_MESSAGE`: one sentence on what changed. Run even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --reply-thread-ids PRRT_base --message "$CHANGE_MESSAGE" --require-sha HEAD`
